# docker_service (Data Source)

Looks up one swarm service (`GET /services/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. `inspect` holds the whole Engine service object (spec, endpoint, update status), `published_ports` the ports it publishes; only the container environment inside it is sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_service" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

# Pin a downstream deployment to the exact image the service runs.
output "web_image" {
  value = data.docker_service.web.image_digest_ref
}

output "web_published_ports" {
  value = [for p in data.docker_service.web.published_ports : p.published_port]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Service ID or a unique ID prefix; resolved to the full ID. Conflicts with `name`.
- `name` (String) Service name. Conflicts with `id`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of inspect_json; changes whenever the object changes.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max).
- `image_digest_ref` (String) Image the tasks run, pinned by digest (`repo@sha256:...`); null when the daemon did not pin one.
- `inspect` (Attributes) The service inspect response as a nested object mirroring Service field by field (snake_case). Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inspect))
- `inspect_json` (String, Sensitive) The exact Engine API inspect response for the service, as JSON. Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the service (`Spec.Labels`).
- `published_ports` (Attributes List) Endpoint.Ports: the ports actually published, after the manager assigned any PublishedPort. Non-sensitive copy for handoff. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--published_ports))
- `replicas` (Number) Wanted task count of a replicated service; null for global and job services.
- `version_index` (Number) The service object's `Version.Index`; it changes on every update.
